title: feat(nm2axp): two-axis opposite seed forall-perp: reverse HOLD, face HOLD
science: Two-axis opposite seed, y-probes, forall-orthogonal. Establishes the seed's tick structure (probes form at 0,1,1,2 vs the one-axis seed's 0,2,1,3 - the second seed pair accelerates formation and is a new seed, not a formed child) and separates forall-perp (hold/hold) from exist-opposite of M (hold/fail) on the same cell.
